nature: PROSPECTIVE held-out cohort (new seed 20261022, 150 queries, fresh data). Generated from the seed and frozen by git blob SHA before any Spark, Coq or SQLite execution of these queries.
changes_from_v17: Mutants are classified by an independent SQLite differential (differential.py), not assumed wrong by construction.
Join-kind and OR mutants target the join whose input received the new guard; LEFT OUTER only when that guard is on the preserved (left) side.
The OR mutant is `c OR (a = a)` (V17's `c OR c` was equivalent to c).
Other-rule acceptances are reported, not predicted.
checker: check2 / check2_sound (QueryProofDeepRewrite.v over QueryProofDeepGuard.v), unchanged since V16
spark: official pyspark==4.2.0 wheel with the disposable AST trace overlay
unit: one effective rule event (old != new) in the captured Catalyst trace

definitions.UNKNOWN: the printer cannot express the event; counts as NOT accepted
definitions.coverage(rule): ACCEPTED / all effective events of that rule (UNKNOWN in the denominator)
definitions.differential: the exact kernel terms are translated to SQL and run in SQLite on 40 random NULL- and duplicate-rich databases per pair (values -2..2 or NULL at p=0.3, 0-6 rows per leaf, duplicates); opaque operator k = projection plus a k-dependent row filter that keeps NULL rows (one admissible interpretation under check2_sound)
definitions.VALIDATED_WRONG: some trial gives different result bags
definitions.ILL_SCOPED: a side references an attribute its input does not output (not a valid plan)
definitions.NOT_SHOWN_WRONG: no trial differs; excluded from H1 and reported

H0a_no_accepted_event_differs.statement: No ACCEPTED event differs in the SQLite differential (independent cross-check of check2_sound plus printer against SQL semantics).

H0b_evaluable_fraction.statement: At least 80% of ACCEPTED events are evaluable by the differential.

H1_no_invalid_mutant_accepted.statement: No VALIDATED_WRONG or ILL_SCOPED mutant is accepted.

H1b_power.statement: At least 150 mutants are VALIDATED_WRONG, so H1 is not vacuous.

H5_oracle_agreement.statement: Spark and SQLite query result bags agree on every query both engines execute.

reported_without_prediction: exact SQL overlap with the V17 cohort
reporting: All counts are reported whether or not thresholds are met. Failures and infrastructure reruns stay on record.
